ctx.x: Could be possible. I know I play his Wildflower Rag quite a lot, and that one was published on 13-something Tulane Avenue.
Who are some of the other composers that you remember hearing or talking to around you? For example, did you know Uncle Sammy Rosenbaum? Sammy Rosenbaum, yeah.

I knew Sammy quite well. He wrote a tune with Joe Burgess too. I've got the music home, but I can't remember the title. I wish I had it right now. But I remember seeing his name on the tune with Joe Burgess. And I'm sure that must be him, because it says Sam Rosenbaum.
